findings.title: Fallback locales are only loaded during web requests, so fallbacks silently fail in mailers, background jobs, and other non-request code
findings.body: Translations are loaded lazily per-locale by the translate accelerator: I18n.translate only loads config.locale, and the only place that loads the full fallback chain (current locale, SiteSetting.default_locale, :en) is this new before_filter via I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!. Any code that translates outside the request cycle (Sidekiq jobs, ActionMailer views, rake tasks, console, plugins) never runs set_locale, so in those processes only the active locale's yml file is ever loaded. When a key is missing in that locale, I18n::Backend::Fallbacks will dutifully try the site default and :en, but those locales' translations were never loaded into the backend, so the lookup raises MissingTranslationData and the output is a 'translation missing: ...' string instead of the English/default fallback this PR is meant to provide. The loading of the fallback chain should live in the accelerator itself (e.g., in I18n.translate/load_locale, iterate I18n.fallbacks[config.locale] and ensure each locale is loaded) rather than only in ApplicationController#set_locale.

findings.title: No tests cover the new server-side fallback behavior
findings.body: This PR changes translation lookup for every locale in every environment (fallback chain current locale -> SiteSetting.default_locale -> :en, lazy loading of that chain via FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!, and removal of config.i18n.fallbacks from the environment configs), but adds no specs. Nothing verifies that a key missing from the active locale falls back to the site default and then to :en, that FallbackLocaleList#[] builds the expected chain (including uniq/compact behavior when locale == default == :en), or that ensure_loaded! actually loads every locale in the chain. A regression here would surface as untranslated or 'translation missing' strings across the whole site, so coverage of this initializer and the set_locale integration is warranted before merging.
